schema.name: agg_group
schema.sql: CREATE TABLE agg_group (tenant TEXT NOT NULL, gkey TEXT NOT NULL, body TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY (tenant, gkey)) WITHOUT ROWID

schema.name: alert
schema.sql: CREATE TABLE alert (tenant TEXT NOT NULL, fp TEXT NOT NULL, body TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY (tenant, fp)) WITHOUT ROWID

schema.name: meta
schema.sql: CREATE TABLE meta (tenant TEXT NOT NULL, k TEXT NOT NULL, v TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY (tenant, k)) WITHOUT ROWID

schema.name: notify_log
schema.sql: CREATE TABLE notify_log (tenant TEXT NOT NULL, monitor TEXT NOT NULL, body TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY (tenant, monitor)) WITHOUT ROWID

schema.name: outbox
schema.sql: CREATE TABLE outbox (tenant TEXT NOT NULL, id INTEGER NOT NULL, gkey TEXT NOT NULL, receiver TEXT NOT NULL, integration TEXT NOT NULL, url TEXT NOT NULL, idem_key TEXT NOT NULL, body TEXT NOT NULL, status TEXT NOT NULL, attempts INTEGER NOT NULL, created_at INTEGER NOT NULL, next_attempt_at INTEGER NOT NULL, last_error TEXT, subjects TEXT, PRIMARY KEY (tenant, id)) WITHOUT ROWID

schema.name: self
schema.sql: CREATE TABLE self (one INTEGER PRIMARY KEY CHECK (one = 1), name TEXT NOT NULL)

schema.name: silence
schema.sql: CREATE TABLE silence (tenant TEXT NOT NULL, id TEXT NOT NULL, body TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY (tenant, id)) WITHOUT ROWID

schema.name: viz_schema
schema.sql: CREATE TABLE viz_schema (one INTEGER PRIMARY KEY CHECK (one = 1), component TEXT NOT NULL, version INTEGER NOT NULL, compat INTEGER NOT NULL, updated_at INTEGER NOT NULL)
